comments.author: DreadPirateWesley
comments.body:
@Lisa: iirc, the sequence is as follows after talking to the Consul...

1. Leave Santiago for Panama (Please note you cannot use the Canal Transport ship IF you've already opened Panama Canal as this is a timed IQ, not too sure if you can use it going back but I think it still applies as well)
2. Talk to the Barkeep in Panama
3. Talk to Port Official twice in Panama
4. Return to Santiago to report.
